note: Values the Character Adapter uses ONLY for optional wardrobe fields a cast leaves empty. They are deliberately different from every rig default in renderers/flat_cartoon_v2/rig/10_chars.js (Kim identity colours and generic placeholders), so an unset field can never fall through to the rig, and a leak is always detectable. Identity fields (skin, hair_color, eye_color) and outfit/top are never filled from here: they must come from the locked cast.

lip_rule.note: lip is derived from the character's own skin (mixed toward a muted rose), never a fixed colour: two characters with different skin get different lips, and none inherits the rig's #c4666b / #d98a86.
